accessibility_best_practices_justificati: No graphical user interface; interaction is via Telegram text commands.
automated_integration_testing_justificat: GitHub Actions CI on every push/PR runs unit tests, static analysis, two ESP-IDF builds and fuzzing: https://github.com/Fairen8/esp32-zapret/actions
build_common_tools_justification: Uses CMake and the ESP-IDF build system.
build_floss_tools_justification: Built with the FLOSS ESP-IDF toolchain and CMake; no proprietary tools required.
build_justification: Builds with ESP-IDF (idf.py build); CI builds on every change.
build_non_recursive_justification: Single-pass CMake/ESP-IDF build; no recursive make or directory recursion.
build_preserve_debug_justification: ESP-IDF builds include debug information (-g) by default.
build_repeatable_justification: Built with the pinned ESP-IDF v5.3.6 toolchain from versioned sources; CI rebuilds the project on every change. Bit-for-bit reproducibility is not claimed.
build_standard_variables_justification: Standard CMake/ESP-IDF variables are used (idf.py build; configuration via Kconfig/sdkconfig, -D options).
bus_factor_justification: Single-maintainer project (bus factor 1); continuity is covered by the public MIT-licensed repository.
coding_standards_enforced_justification: Enforced in CI: builds treat warnings as errors (-Werror), CodeQL static analysis gates changes, the fuzz job runs on every change, and all changes require a pull request (branch protection).
crypto_algorithm_agility_justification: Cipher suites and curves are configurable through mbedTLS; no hardcoded single algorithm.
crypto_certificate_verification_justific: Mandatory certificate verification with the ESP-IDF CA bundle and hostname verification (api.telegram.org).
crypto_credential_agility_justification: No long-lived cryptographic credentials are stored or embedded; TLS session keys are ephemeral and re-negotiated per connection.
crypto_floss_justification: mbedTLS is FLOSS (Apache-2.0) and part of ESP-IDF.
crypto_password_storage_justification: The software stores no passwords or credentials.
crypto_pfs_justification: ECDHE key exchange provides forward secrecy.
crypto_published_justification: No custom cryptography: TLS via mbedTLS using published algorithms (ECDHE, AES-GCM, SHA-256).
crypto_random_justification: TLS randomness from mbedTLS CTR-DRBG seeded by the ESP32 hardware RNG.
crypto_tls12_justification: TLS 1.2+ is used via mbedTLS with modern cipher suites.
crypto_used_network_justification: TLS is the transport for all network communication.
crypto_verification_private_justificatio: Verified TLS channels are used for all private/authenticated communication.
crypto_weaknesses_justification: Only modern primitives via mbedTLS (ECDHE, AES-GCM, SHA-256); weak algorithms disabled by defaults.
crypto_working_justification: TLS is used in production (Telegram Bot API over HTTPS) with CA-bundle certificate verification.
dco_justification: No DCO or CLA is required; contributions are accepted under the project license via pull requests.
delivery_mitm_justification: Distribution via GitHub Releases over HTTPS; certificate verification enforced in the firmware.
delivery_unsigned_justification: Release artifacts carry signed SLSA build provenance (GitHub artifact attestations).
dependency_monitoring_justification: Dependabot alerts and automated security fixes are enabled; CodeQL runs on every push/PR and weekly.
description_good_justification: README opens with a clear project description; README.en.md provides the same in English.
discussion_justification: GitHub issues and pull requests; community PRs via the community branch.
documentation_achievements_justification: Achievements documented in README (OpenSSF badges, CodeQL, fuzzing, provenance): https://github.com/Fairen8/esp32-zapret/blob/main/README.md#достижения
documentation_basics_justification: README (RU/EN) and INSTALL_RU.md cover installation, configuration and usage; release archives ship INSTALL_RU.md.
documentation_current_justification: Documentation is updated together with changes (see MAINTENANCE.md); current for release v0.2.5.
documentation_interface_justification: Bot commands table in README and the component API in include/esp_desync.h.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: Fuzz target and tests use invariant assertions (__builtin_trap) enabled in CI builds.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: No dynamic-analysis findings so far; any crash fails CI immediately and is fixed before release.
dynamic_analysis_justification: libFuzzer target for the TLS parser with ASan/UBSan, 90 seconds per CI run.
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: Fuzzing runs under AddressSanitizer and UBSan on memory-unsafe C code.
english_justification: README.en.md and all code comments are in English; issues/PRs accepted in English.
enhancement_responses_justification: No feature requests filed so far; the maintainer reviews every issue and community PR.
external_dependencies_justification: Direct dependencies declared in the component manifest: https://github.com/Fairen8/esp32-zapret/blob/main/components/esp_desync/idf_component.yml (ESP-IDF >= 5.1; LwIP, mbedTLS from ESP-IDF).
governance_justification: Governance model, roles and decision process: https://github.com/Fairen8/esp32-zapret/blob/main/docs/GOVERNANCE.md
hardening_justification: OS-level hardening flags do not apply to bare-metal ESP32 firmware; transport security is provided by verified TLS.
implement_secure_design_justification: Secure design principles and threat model: https://github.com/Fairen8/esp32-zapret/blob/main/docs/SECURITY_DESIGN.md
input_validation_justification: Bounds-checked TLS parser plus continuous fuzzing: https://github.com/Fairen8/esp32-zapret/blob/main/docs/SECURITY_DESIGN.md#input-validation
installation_common_justification: Standard ESP-IDF installation flow documented: idf.py set-target/build/flash; quick start in docs/QUICKSTART.md.
installation_standard_variables_justific: Installation/build uses standard ESP-IDF variables and options (Kconfig/sdkconfig, CMake -D flags).
interact_justification: Interaction channels documented: GitHub issues for bugs/ideas and the community branch for pull requests.
interfaces_current_justification: Interface documentation (bot commands table and component API header) is kept current.
internationalization_justification: No user-facing GUI requiring internationalization; documentation is available in English and Russian.
know_common_errors_justification: Common pitfalls addressed: no secrets in the repo (secret scanning, gitignored secrets.h), strict input bounds in the TLS parser, fuzzing.
know_secure_design_justification: README explains the design and threat model (DPI adversary); DISCLAIMER documents assumptions.
maintained_justification: Actively maintained: automated CI/CD, latest release v0.2.5, current activity.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: Secret scanning with push protection, CI hygiene job, full history audited; only secrets_example.h is tracked.
regression_tests_added50_justification: No regressions fixed to date; the test policy requires tests with fixes (CONTRIBUTING.md).
release_notes_vulns_justification: No vulnerabilities fixed so far; any future fix is tracked in GitHub Security Advisories and noted in the CHANGELOG.
repo_interim_justification: Development happens in public between releases: every change goes through pull requests with CI.
report_archive_justification: GitHub issues form a public, searchable archive: https://github.com/Fairen8/esp32-zapret/issues
report_process_justification: Bug reporting documented in CONTRIBUTING.md and issue templates: https://github.com/Fairen8/esp32-zapret/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
report_responses_justification: No bug reports filed so far; the maintainer is notified of every issue and responds promptly.
roles_responsibilities_justification: Roles and responsibilities are defined in https://github.com/Fairen8/esp32-zapret/blob/main/docs/GOVERNANCE.md
signed_releases_justification: Every release includes signed SLSA build provenance (*.intoto.jsonl, GitHub artifact attestations) for the firmware image and source archive.
sites_https_justification: All project URLs (GitHub, releases, bestpractices.dev) use HTTPS.
sites_password_security_justification: The project operates no website storing passwords; all project sites use GitHub authentication.
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL runs its security query suite (CWE) on every push/PR.
static_analysis_fixed_justification: CodeQL currently reports 0 alerts; findings gate CI.
static_analysis_justification: CodeQL (C/C++) on every push/PR plus gcc -fanalyzer in CI.
static_analysis_often_justification: Static analysis runs on every push and pull request, plus weekly.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: GitHub Actions runs on every push/PR (tests, CodeQL, fuzzing); CI badge in README.
test_invocation_justification: Tests invoked via 'bash tests/host/run.sh' and 'idf.py build'; CI runs them.
test_justification: Host unit tests (tests/host/run.sh) plus fuzzing and CI builds.
test_most_justification: Core platform-independent logic (TLS ClientHello parser/builder, net utils) is unit-tested; hardware paths covered by CI build and field testing.
test_policy_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md requires tests; branch protection enforces green CI before merge.
test_policy_mandated_justification: Test policy mandated in CONTRIBUTING.md and enforced by branch protection (green CI required for merge).
test_statement_coverage80_justification: Statement coverage measurement is not applicable to the hardware-dependent firmware as a whole; the platform-independent core is unit-tested on host (tests/host), and firmware paths are covered by CI builds and field testing.
tests_are_added_justification: Tests were added together with the core features (tests/host) and are expected with changes.
updateable_reused_components_justificati: Reused components are managed via the ESP-IDF component manager (idf_component.yml); GitHub Actions are SHA-pinned and updated by Dependabot.
version_tags_justification: Every release is tagged in git (vX.Y.Z).
version_tags_signed_justification: Git tags are not GPG-signed; release provenance is provided via SLSA attestations instead.
version_unique_justification: Unique release versions: VERSION file and git tags v0.1.1 through v0.2.5.
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: No known vulnerabilities; critical fixes ship through the automated release pipeline.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: No known vulnerabilities; Dependabot and CodeQL continuously monitor dependencies and code.
vulnerability_report_credit_justificatio: Reporters are publicly credited (unless anonymous), see SECURITY.md: https://github.com/Fairen8/esp32-zapret/blob/main/SECURITY.md
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: Private reporting via GitHub Security Advisories: https://github.com/Fairen8/esp32-zapret/security/advisories/new
vulnerability_report_process_justificati: SECURITY.md documents the vulnerability reporting process: https://github.com/Fairen8/esp32-zapret/blob/main/SECURITY.md
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: No reports so far; the maintainer responds via the private advisory channel.
vulnerability_response_process_justifica: Response process and timelines documented in SECURITY.md: https://github.com/Fairen8/esp32-zapret/blob/main/SECURITY.md
warnings_fixed_justification: CI compiles with warnings-as-errors; the code builds warning-free.
warnings_justification: Strict warnings: ESP-IDF builds with -Werror=all, host tests with -Wall -Wextra -Werror.
warnings_strict_justification: Builds use -Werror=all (ESP-IDF) and -Wall -Wextra -Werror for host code and analyzer jobs.
